exercises.name: Wall push-up
exercises.rationale: Shoulder horizontal adduction (chest, front delt) + elbow extension (triceps). Core is isometric only, so 0.

exercises.name: High incline push-up
exercises.rationale: Shoulder horizontal adduction (chest, front delt) + elbow extension (triceps). Core is isometric only, so 0.

exercises.name: Knee push-up
exercises.rationale: Shoulder horizontal adduction (chest, front delt) + elbow extension (triceps). Core is isometric only, so 0.

exercises.name: Low incline push-up
exercises.rationale: Shoulder horizontal adduction (chest, front delt) + elbow extension (triceps). Core is isometric only, so 0.

exercises.name: Standard push-up
exercises.rationale: Shoulder horizontal adduction (chest, front delt) + elbow extension (triceps). Core is isometric only, so 0.

exercises.name: Decline push-up
exercises.rationale: Shoulder horizontal adduction (chest, front delt) + elbow extension (triceps). Core is isometric only, so 0. Feet elevated shifts load up the chest; tiers unchanged.

exercises.name: Deficit push-up
exercises.rationale: Shoulder horizontal adduction (chest, front delt) + elbow extension (triceps). Core is isometric only, so 0. Deficit stretches the chest under load (lengthened).

exercises.name: Archer push-up
exercises.rationale: Shoulder horizontal adduction (chest, front delt) + elbow extension (triceps). Core is isometric only, so 0. Working arm takes most of the load; logged per side.

exercises.name: Pseudo-planche push-up
exercises.rationale: Forward lean makes shoulder flexion torque dominant: front delt joins chest at 1. Elbow extension (triceps) 0.5. Biceps/core isometric, so 0.

exercises.name: Pike push-up
exercises.rationale: Shoulder flexion overhead (front delt) + elbow extension (triceps). Upper chest assists a little (0.25).

exercises.name: Elevated pike push-up
exercises.rationale: Feet elevated puts more bodyweight overhead. Same joint actions as pike push-up.

exercises.name: Wall handstand hold
exercises.rationale: Isometric overhead support: front delt holds full bodyweight, triceps lock the elbow (0.5). No length change. defaultM is in repsEq (3 s each).

exercises.name: Partial wall handstand push-up
exercises.rationale: Full-bodyweight shoulder flexion (front delt) + elbow extension (triceps) over a partial range.

exercises.name: Wall handstand push-up
exercises.rationale: Full range to the floor: triceps work through a long range under full bodyweight, so both front delt and triceps are 1.

exercises.name: Wide push-up
exercises.rationale: Wider hands bias horizontal adduction (chest) over elbow extension, so triceps drop to 0.25.

exercises.name: Band chest press
exercises.rationale: Band anchored behind you: horizontal adduction (chest, front delt) + elbow extension (triceps). Tension peaks at lockout, so not lengthened.

exercises.name: Band chest fly
exercises.rationale: Horizontal adduction with fixed elbows: chest isolation, front delt assists.

exercises.name: Band shoulder press
exercises.rationale: Pressing overhead from a band under the feet: shoulder flexion (front delt) + elbow extension (triceps).

exercises.name: Band lateral raise
exercises.rationale: Shoulder abduction: side delts. Traps help at the top.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.rationale: Horizontal adduction (chest, front delt) + elbow extension (triceps) lying on a bench.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.rationale: Incline bench shifts the press toward upper chest and front delt.

exercises.name: Dumbbell floor press
exercises.rationale: Press from the floor: the floor stops the elbows, so a shorter range with a triceps-heavy lockout.

exercises.name: Dumbbell fly
exercises.rationale: Horizontal adduction with fixed elbows; load peaks with the arms open, so the chest works lengthened.

exercises.name: Dumbbell shoulder press
exercises.rationale: Standing overhead press: shoulder flexion (front delt) + elbow extension (triceps); the trunk braces.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell shoulder press
exercises.rationale: Overhead press seated on a bench: same joints as standing, less trunk work.

exercises.name: Arnold press
exercises.rationale: Overhead press with a rotation from palms-in to palms-out: front delt leads, side delt joins as the arms open.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
exercises.rationale: Shoulder abduction: side delts. Traps help at the top.

exercises.name: Dumbbell front raise
exercises.rationale: Shoulder flexion with a straight arm: front delt isolation.

exercises.name: Dumbbell upright row
exercises.rationale: Shoulder abduction with bent elbows: side delts and upper traps; biceps help slightly.
